extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: escalator for one storey, 30 degrees, 3.0 m rise, 1.0 m steps, 1.6 x 8.0 x 4.05 m
extras.notes: fills 1 x 4 cells of the 2 m grid (x -0.8..+0.8, y -4..+4, origin bottom centre); bottom z = 0, placed on the floor tiles (z = 0.1) the upper landing lies on the next storey's floor level (3.1) like modular-stairs, going up towards +Y; 14 steps with cleats and yellow safety edges, comb plates at both landings, stainless skirt and deck, glass balustrade with coral handrails looping at both ends, white support column under the upper end; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
